summary: Iteration 18 SEO frontend verification: dynamic <title>, semantic anchor CTAs, folder-aware alt tags and per-route meta keywords tested across Home, Portfolio, Works (Residential/Commercial/Restoration cats + Bedrooms/Retail/Hospitality/Office/Kitchens folders). 16/17 requested checks pass. 1 failure: on `/` the meta[name=keywords] does NOT contain the required phrase 'Free home interior consultation'. Iter17 pagination regressions remain intact.

ui_bugs.issue: meta[name=keywords] on `/` is missing the approved phrase 'Free home interior consultation'. keywordsFor() for the home surface pulls only KEYWORDS.residential.slice(0,8) which stops at 'Unique house ideas'; 'Free home interior consultation' sits at residential index 26 and is therefore excluded on Home (present on all Residential surfaces, only Home fails).

action_items: Fix keywordsFor() in /app/frontend/src/lib/seo.js so the Home ('/') meta keywords include 'Free home interior consultation' (and ideally 'Free designing consultation'). Options: (a) include specific high-intent phrases like Free home interior consultation, Modular kitchen design, Luxury bedroom designs in the Home bundle explicitly, or (b) widen residential.slice range on Home, or (c) append the whole KEYWORDS.residential/commercial/restoration lists (still deduped) on Home.
critical_code_review_comments: seo.js keywordsFor() home branch uses arbitrary slice indices (residential.slice(0,8), commercial.slice(0,6), restoration.slice(0,6)) — this silently drops high-intent phrases like 'Free home interior consultation'. Prefer a curated Home bundle constant instead of index-based slicing so approved keywords cannot be lost when the arrays are reordered.

altFor() returns null-safe fallback string, good — but folder cover images on category listings (RESIDENTIAL/COMMERCIAL/RESTORATION pages) did not expose a [data-testid^=works-child-item-] img (test found none). If FolderCards are supposed to use altFor per PR description, confirm alt is still applied even though the DOM node uses a different testid.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified (PASS): Home title, Bedrooms/Retail/Hospitality/Office/Kitchens/Restoration folder+category titles all match; Residential/Commercial/Restoration meta keywords contain all required phrases; Bedrooms & Retail first-img alt text match required semantic phrases; Home CTA text 'BROWSE RESIDENTIAL, COMMERCIAL & RESTORATION PROJECTS'; Portfolio CTAs 'BROWSE THE FULL INTERIOR DESIGN GALLERY' and 'BOOK A FREE DESIGN CONSULTATION WITH THE STUDIO'; iter17 pagination selectors (works-child-pagination on Hall&Dining, gallery-pagination on gallery Bedrooms) still render. FAIL: Home '/' meta keywords missing 'Free home interior consultation'.
rca of the issue: keywordsFor({}) on Home uses base.push(...KEYWORDS.residential.slice(0, 8)). 'Free home interior consultation' is at index 26 of KEYWORDS.residential, so it is truncated on Home. Fix by widening the slice or by curating an explicit Home keyword list that includes the phrase.
